<patch operator="WrapFallback" anchor="guarded_flight"><subtree><ReactiveSequence>
  <IsBatteryOk min_pct="{min_batt}" />
  <IsInsideGeofence margin_m="0" />
  <Sequence>
    <ForceSuccess>
      <GoToRequiredGoal velocity="{vel}" timeout_s="90" arrive_tol_m="1.5" />
    </ForceSuccess>
    <ReturnToLaunch timeout_s="120" velocity="{vel}" arrive_tol_m="2.0" />
    <Land timeout_s="60" />
  </Sequence>
</ReactiveSequence></subtree><tunable_ports><port name="min_batt" min="10" max="20" initial="12" /><port name="vel" min="3" max="8" initial="5" /></tunable_ports><rationale>Wrap the main guarded_flight in a Fallback. If the conservative 25% battery guard fails, the fallback executes a new ReactiveSequence with a lower battery threshold. It uses GoToRequiredGoal to complete the remaining required goal ('lane1'), wrapped in ForceSuccess to ensure the sequence continues. It then safely returns to launch and lands, skipping the optional goals to save battery.</rationale></patch>
